title: Node Identity and Host Profiles
summary: Managed Node Host Profiles provide a provider-neutral vocabulary for node identity and capability, separating the allocator's stable nodeId from transient resource identity.
why: Allows the system to track a node's capability and provenance independently of its network endpoint or cloud-provider resource ID.
invariants: The stable allocator nodeId is separate from provider resource identity and network endpoint.
Host profiles supply declared finite task abilities derived from Managed Node task kinds.
Capability facts (installed CPU/RAM/disk) are distinct from expiring observations (free CPU/RAM/disk).
